165:t_10:20.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
(You idiot... You never understood how I felt, right to the end...)

165:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Cry all you need to, $$ミヒロ$$. I'll keep everyone out until you've cried your heart out.)

165:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(There will be no celebration for ace pilots today, either. Even I cannot bring myself to do that...)

165:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(...There's no point dwelling on it. Humans and robots alike can only give their all to what's before them.)

165:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(For me, that means collecting $$Ｚチップ$$s... So whatever happens, I'll open $$Ｄトレーダー$$.)

165:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Today, I'll quietly... get on with business...)

166:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ detected our movements too.」

166:t_000:2.en:
$$メラン$$
「We have no choice but to hold out here until the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ arrives.」

166:t_000:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「We'll be fine. We've got the Colonel here.」

166:t_000:4.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Hey, $$クェス$$. Don't forget me, a member of $$ロンド・ベル$$'s elite $$トライスター$$, and...」

166:t_000:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「You'd better not forget me from $$エコーズ$$ either.」

166:t_000:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「I trust you and the others too, Captain $$ナイジェル$$. The problem is...」

166:t_000:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$... I can't smile like I used to anymore.」

166:t_000:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「...I haven't sorted it out myself yet. So I can't tell you anything.」

166:t_000:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But I will say this. I'll fight for what I believe in.」

166:t_000:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「And I'll defeat you, without fail. Fair and square.」

166:t_000:15.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「You seem to have put some of it behind you.」

166:t_000:16.en:
$$ブライト$$
(That's right, Ensign $$リディ$$. You're still young...)

166:t_000:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
(See with your own eyes, listen with your own ears, and act on your own judgment. For your own sake.)

166:t_000:18.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Can you fight, $$バナージ$$?」

166:t_000:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... I'm sorry for worrying you, Major $$コンロイ$$.」

166:t_000:20.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I... don't intend to waste what Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$ taught me.」

166:t_000:21.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those words... are the finest tribute to our late Lieutenant Colonel.」

166:t_000:22.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Can you hear me, $$バナージ$$?」

166:t_000:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Let me continue our earlier talk for a little longer.」

166:t_000:25.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I want to believe the $$ガンダム$$ chose you, just as it chose those who piloted one before you.」

166:t_000:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「In the end, it was always inevitable. For better or worse. But...」

166:t_000:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The rest is up to you. Don't let circumstances crush you.」

166:t_000:31.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Have the courage to reject despair.)

166:t_000:32.en:
$$ブライト$$
(If you're a $$ガンダム$$ pilot... a $$ニュータイプ$$.)

166:t_000:33.en:
$$メラン$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is coming!」

166:t_001:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「Look, Colonel! $$ギュネイ$$ is there too!」

166:t_001:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$クェス$$...! So you were with $$シャア$$ after all...!」

166:t_001:4.en:
$$メラン$$
「Does $$ネオ・ジオン$$ know that Her Highness $$ミネバ$$ is with us?」

166:t_001:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Probably. Otherwise, they wouldn't attack at this particular moment.」

166:t_001:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Your Highness $$ミネバ$$. Please withdraw somewhere safe. The bridge is dangerous.」

166:t_001:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you for your concern, Captain... and for considering that my comrades are after my life.」

166:t_001:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
(This girl... understands her position...)

166:t_001:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no problem, $$ブライト$$. There are people here with the strength to protect her.」

166:t_001:12.en:
$$リディ$$
(I'll protect you... even if you never become mine...)

166:t_001:13.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Colonel, it's the $$角割れ$$.」

166:t_001:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Just as the intelligence said. We've incurred another debt to $$アマルガム$$...」

166:t_001:15.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Did they discover the $$サイコ・モニター$$ fitted to the $$角割れ$$ and remove it?」

166:t_001:16.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「After the battle at $$ダカール$$, the $$サイコ・モニター$$ cut out. As a result, we can no longer obtain the Box's coordinates...」

166:t_001:17.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The output of the $$ユニコーン$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ probably exceeded our expectations and caused the monitor to malfunction.」

166:t_001:18.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「But if we capture it here, there will be no problem.」

166:t_001:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll hold off $$シャア・アズナブル$$. $$アンジェロ$$ and $$ギュネイ$$, take care of the $$ユニコーン$$ and the battleship.」

166:t_001:20.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Leader... Please leave the man who betrayed $$ジオン$$ to me.」

166:t_001:21.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$...! You dare object to the Leader's plan?」

166:t_001:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's fine, $$アンジェロ$$. $$ギュネイ$$ must have grievances he can no longer stomach.」

166:t_001:23.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll leave disposing of $$シャア・アズナブル$$ to you, $$ギュネイ$$. I'll command from the rear.」

166:t_001:24.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(Colonel...! I'll surpass you here!)

166:t_001:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「Stay back, $$クェス$$. $$ギュネイ$$ will come after me.」

166:t_001:26.en:
$$クェス$$
「I won't stay back, especially if $$ギュネイ$$ is coming!」

166:t_001:27.en:
$$クェス$$
「But I won't be fighting him! I'll wake $$ギュネイ$$ up from following that creep $$フロンタル$$!」

166:t_001:28.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I understand. I'll leave $$ギュネイ$$ to you, $$クェス$$.」

166:t_001:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$! But don't overextend yourselves!」

166:t_001:30.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「$$ダリル$$, $$ワッツ$$! I'm counting on you to guard the $$ラー・カイラム$$!」

166:t_001:32.en:
$$ワッツ$$
「We're counting on you at the front!」

166:t_001:33.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Hold out until the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ arrives, whatever it takes!」

166:t_001:34.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$... It's time for you to leave this world.」

166:t_002:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain! A ship is charging toward us!」

166:t_002:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Is it a detached force!?」
